title: Principal Cone Koszul Roos Comparison
statement: On a small ringed site, let P be any cochain complex and μ its scalar endomorphism for a compatible global section a. The principal cone completion of μ is isomorphic in the derived category to the strict tensor singleton-Koszul Roos complex. The comparison sends the specified principal cone unit to the prescribed Koszul Roos unit. The statement uses the displayed countable-product and derived-category hypotheses and requires no regularity or K-flatness. Dependencies: [lem-pur-principal-koszul-roos-presentation-comparison], [def-pur-principal-cone-tower].

proof.text: tensoring a mapping cone with P commutes with that mapping cone, including its two inclusions. The unit-tensor isomorphism conjugates scalar multiplication on P to tensoring scalar multiplication on the unit. Taking powers therefore gives an isomorphism from each scalar cone to its tensor Koszul level. Naturality of the tensor-cone comparison identifies the (scalar,identity) transition squares, and its inclusion formula identifies the augmentations. Compare the products and their one-minus-shift endomorphisms, then their mapping cocones. The normalized comparison carries the zero-homotopy lift of the original augmentation to the tensor Koszul Roos unit. All finite level comparisons are isomorphisms; neither regularity of the scalar nor K-flatness or boundedness of P enters this calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem principalConeKoszulRoosComparison
    (P : CochainComplex 𝒜 ℤ)
    (a : (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (μ : End P)
    (hμ : ∀ (q : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X q).val.obj U),
      (μ.f q).val.app U x =
        @SMul.smul _ _ ((P.X q).val.obj U).isModule.toSMul (a.val U) x) :
    ∃ e : (DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := 𝒜)).obj (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.completion (A := 𝒜)
      (P := P) μ) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := 𝒜)).obj
          ((roosF (A := 𝒜)).obj (koszulTowerComplex R (koszulTensorTower R P ⟨a.val, a.property⟩))),
      (DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := 𝒜)).map (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.unit (A := 𝒜) (P := P) μ)
        ≫ e.hom =
        (DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := 𝒜)).map (principalKoszulRoosUnit R P ⟨a.val, a.property⟩)
